Oni New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Oni, Georgia

Not demolished. Oni's newer Jewish cemetery, near the same historic community described for the Old Jewish Cemetery (peak population 3,500 before 1972-1992 emigration to Israel, home to Georgia's third-largest synagogue and Zionist pioneer Rabbi David Baazov), preserves inscriptions from notable community figures including rabbis. Its oldest legible tombstone dates to 1954, its most recent to 2003. A Holocaust and Righteous Among the Nations memorial (honoring Sergey Metreveli) was unveiled here in 2020, matching a twin memorial at the Old Cemetery.
